acceptanceCriteria: A declared operation by the current holder on its ALLOCATED member runs once and records a receipt; a non-holder is refused.
Tests cover holder, non-holder and replay.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1585 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1104, head 2215d54aa, PSR-V0-160..167); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1585-pool-member-lifecycle.md. GitHub #1028 stays open for these. Expected: the allocation holder can run declared operations (e.g. refresh, reset) on its own ALLOCATED member with a recorded receipt. Actual: operations start only from FREE or QUARANTINED, so a holder must release first.
title: pool operate: the holder of an ALLOCATED member cannot run lifecycle operations (refresh/reset on a held member)
